prereg.motivation: The audit at experiments/banc-control-audit/20261109T053534Z found that (a) the actuator's own 2 rad/s rate limit masked most policy output in the legacy interface, (b) training, evaluation and the renderer each ran a different base-network/observation schedule, (c) the 294 history features were the frozen base network's own predictions rather than the agent's commands, (d) the six foot loads reached the sensory encoder in a different leg order than the encoder declares, (e) PPO used no bootstrap at time-limit truncation and a cumulative rather than windowed slip cost, and (f) the pad-clearance lookup still used a single-pad exact name on a three-sphere body.
what_changes: one control path: repair_core.Core is used by the probe, the trainer and (later) the renderer; nothing else implements a schedule

the policy owns the full actuator authority: rate = action * 2.0 rad/s, the actuator's own limit, so no saturated tracking term can mask it; the frozen base network is demoted to warm-start data only and never acts at evaluation
the 294 history features are the last 7 own commanded targets over a 40-tick ring buffer
foot loads are handed to the sensory encoder in its declared order LF LM LH RF RM RH
pad geometry is found by prefix over all three triad spheres per leg
PPO: bootstrap at time-limit truncation, discount and GAE declared as a time horizon, per-step slip cost with a fixed window, signed forward velocity
what_does_not_change: the four frozen walking gates (support min >= 0.90, non-foot <= 4.889 W, COM >= 1.20, per-leg slip ratio <= 0.50) are not touched and are not the target of this round
the derived triad body, doubled actuator range, mu = 1.5 and the releasable adhesion law stay as declared derived models with their existing hashes
no connectome topology, neuron identity or synapse is modified in this round
prereg.round_1_target: single-leg unload-lift-place on the repaired pipeline, measured on all six legs. This is the capability the audit identified as missing; it is a prerequisite for stepping and is not walking.

task_definition.prompt: one-hot over 6 legs, supplied as a declared task instruction input (6 dims), re-drawn per episode; no clock, no phase, no external gait generator
task_definition.start_state: cold start from the solved triad stand pose (COM 1.3008 static), identical for every episode

success_criteria_all_required.unload: min load on the prompted leg <= 0.10 * body weight
success_criteria_all_required.lift: max pad bottom height on the prompted leg >= 0.015 native
success_criteria_all_required.advance: max forward (thorax +x) displacement of the prompted foot during the swing >= 0.03 native
success_criteria_all_required.place: at episode end the prompted leg carries >= 0.10 * body weight with pad bottom height <= 0.004
success_criteria_all_required.safe: support min >= 0.90, non-foot peak <= 4.889 W, COM min >= 1.00 (stage threshold, declared weaker than the 1.20 walking gate)

task_definition.reported_not_gated: other-leg stance slip, signed forward velocity, per-leg lift and advance figures

optimizer.algorithm: PPO, numpy, hand-written gradients plus Adam
optimizer.warm_start: supervised regression of the actor mean onto the frozen base network's rate command (clip(base_rate/2, -1, 1)) over teacher rollouts; the base network is our own frozen artifact, used as initialisation only

preregistered_outcomes.if_all_six_legs_pass: the repaired interface can produce a single supervised-instructed step; next round may train autonomous leg selection and continuous slow walking, still without any clock or external gait generator
preregistered_outcomes.if_unload_and_lift_pass_but_advance_or_p: the body can release and raise a foot but cannot transport or replant it; next diagnosis is the swing trajectory and the actuator's usable workspace, not the reward scale
preregistered_outcomes.if_lift_never_appears: check whether the requested joint-rate authority still exceeds what the leg needs, then whether the adhesion releases; do not raise the actuator limit before that check
preregistered_outcomes.if_safety_fails_only: the single-leg action is achievable but destabilising; next step is a balance/support constraint, not more reward hacking

prereg.labelling: derived body, derived actuator range, derived adhesion, replacement ANN with a task instruction input. Never frozen-body acceptance and never a connectome capability.

prereg_amendment.when: before the main 48-update run, after a measured reward-scale probe

evidence.measured_on: warm-start policy, 6 prompts x 300 ticks, zero PPO updates
evidence.interpretation: the summed stance-slip penalty was 6.53 per tick against 0.236 of combined task reward, i.e. about 28 times larger. Raw summed stance excess averaged 3.27 native/s across the other five legs, which is the same slipping that the earlier line of work found the policy cannot reduce on planted feet. Running with the original weight would have re-created the stand-still degeneracy instead of testing whether a single leg can be lifted.

other_leg_stance_excess.reason: demoted from a driver to a reported quantity; slip remains measured and reported but must not dominate a task that is not about slip yet

omega.reason: body angular-rate penalty was 0.447 per tick, twice the task terms

unchanged.success_criteria: the five pre-registered criteria are untouched
unchanged.optimizer: 48 updates, rollout 1024, epochs 4, lr 3e-4, gamma half-life 1.0 s, GAE 0.99
unchanged.preregistered_outcomes: unchanged, including that no result may be reported as walking

prereg_amendment_2.when: after the imitation-only run, before the demo-initialised PPO run

evidence.observed: with a screened lift direction as the teacher and ZERO PPO updates, five of six legs already reach unload + lift + advance (LF lift 0.0877, LM 1.4083, RF 0.1963, LH 0.7414, RH 0.0739); every leg fails only the 'place' criterion because the foot is still up at the end of the episode
evidence.diagnosis: the declared level-based task reward pays unload+lift continuously, about 2 per tick, while placing is a single event bonus of 2. Holding the foot up for the remaining ticks therefore out-returns placing it, so the reward itself forbids the behaviour the acceptance test requires. This is a defect in my reward design, not a capability finding.

task_terms.reason: potential-based shaping telescopes, so a held state pays nothing and only progress pays

place_hold.reason: dense credit for being loaded again at pad height <= 0.004 after a completed swing, so the terminal placement is not a single sparse event

unchanged.acceptance_criteria: unload 0.10 W, lift 0.015, advance 0.03, place 0.10 W and padz 0.004, safety support 0.90 / non-foot 4.889 W / COM 1.00
unchanged.safety_penalties: non-foot 20, support 30, COM 60, other-leg stance 0.05, action 0.02, omega 0.01, gravity 0.01

evidence.evaluation_at_update_8: LF lift 0.0830 advance 0.3067 but final load 0.000; LM lift 1.4237 advance 0.5825 final load 0.000; RF lift 0.2054 advance 0.0849 final load 0.000
evidence.diagnosis: the potential was built from instantaneous levels, so the state 'foot held in the air' has phi about 3.0 while the state 'step completed and foot back down' has phi about 1.0. Telescoped shaping therefore still prefers ending the episode with the foot up, which is exactly what every evaluation shows.

potential.reason: achievement flags stay set once reached, so completing and placing the foot strictly dominates holding it up; best_advance was already monotone

prereg_amendment_4.when: after the 64-update run, before the next run; found by comparing the training gates with the evaluator

evidence.training_placement_rate: placed_fraction reached a maximum of 0.814 and averaged 0.247 over the last eight updates of the 64-update run
evidence.evaluation_end_load: the same checkpoint ends the deterministic episode with 0.000 to 0.041 body weight on the prompted leg
evidence.codes: train_single_leg.py before this amendment used HIGH = 0.30 * body weight to close a swing and to set the 'placed' flag, while evaluate() calls a leg placed at THRESH['place_load'] = 0.10 * body weight
evidence.diagnosis: the training signal for landing required three times the load that the acceptance test requires, so the dense 'placed' credit was gated behind a state almost never reached (a leg at rest carries about 0.17 body weight). This is a mismatch between my reward code and my own declared criteria, not a capability limit.

swing_start.reason: hysteresis: the swing must start below the acceptance unload bar so that closing at 0.10 cannot chatter at the boundary

swing_end.new: load >= 0.10 * body weight AND pad bottom height <= 0.004
swing_end.reason: this is exactly the acceptance definition of a placement

placed_flag.old: max lift >= 0.008 and load >= 0.30 * body weight
placed_flag.new: max lift >= 0.008 and advanced >= 0.03 and closed at load >= 0.10 with pad <= 0.004
placed_flag.reason: the advance requirement moves from a multiplier on the bonus into a gate, so the bonus is no longer paid for a swing that barely moved

evaluator.old: closed a swing at 0.30 * body weight
evaluator.new: closed at 0.10 * body weight with pad <= 0.004
evaluator.reason: training and evaluation must share one definition of a swing, otherwise the numbers are not comparable

four_arms_compared.300ms_24u: LF lift 0.0214-0.0448, end load 0.036-0.041 (never lifts and lands together)
four_arms_compared.300ms_64u: LF lift 0.0035, end load 0.041; RM end load 0.123 but lift 0.0019

four_arms_compared.300ms_24u_aligned_gates: LF lift 0.1475, end load 0.000; RM end load 0.103 but lift 0.000

evidence.pattern: in every arm each leg does one half of the step and never both: the deterministic policy emits what is effectively a constant action for the whole 300 ms episode, so it either holds the foot up or presses it down
evidence.diagnosis: the previous teacher was itself constant (the screened lift direction for the whole swing), so supervised initialisation could only ever teach a constant action. A sequence cannot come out of a teacher that has no second phase.

form.old: command the screened lift direction while the leg carries load, else zero
form.new: two phases selected by measured state: lift while the leg carries load, keep lifting while the leg has travelled less than half the commanded travel, then command the mirrored (press) direction

switch_signal.new: foot load, then the fraction of commanded joint travel already achieved
switch_signal.reason: the 183-feature sensory vector contains joint angles, tracking error, velocities, targets, foot loads, gravity and body velocities but NOT the pad height, so a pad-height switch would be unobservable to the network being taught. The joint excursion is observable.

teacher_changes.declared_limits: this teacher is a rule-based demonstration generator. The deployed artefact remains the network, which is fine-tuned by PPO with the teacher absent. Nothing in this amendment may be reported as connectome capability, and any result must be labelled 'network initialised from a declared two-phase demonstration'.

prereg_obs_v2.what_this_is: a declared engineering encoding added to the REPLACEMENT ANN observation. It is NOT connectome capability, NOT a new sensory cell, and NOT a change to the 556-cell encoder or its port contract.

motivation.measurement: FOOT_HEIGHT_VISIBILITY.json: a linear decoder recovers 0.6488 of the variance of the per-leg pad height from the full 483-dimensional observation, 0.0594 from the 42 joint angles alone and 0.0445 from the six foot-load channels alone
motivation.observed_failure: in all six arms each leg reaches 4 of the 5 acceptance criteria and the missing one is always either lift or placement; with the two-phase teacher LF lifts to 2.5314 but never comes down (placement rate 0.000)
motivation.inference: the policy has no direct channel for its own foot clearance, so 'lift until the pad clears the ground, then put it back down' must be learned through an inferred inverse-kinematic estimate. Adding the clearance channel tests whether that inference is the binding difficulty.

added_entries.clipping: same declared saturation as the rest of the sensory vector, +/-10

change.carried_caveats: the pad height is derived from the three-sphere triad geometry (per-leg minimum), so it inherits every caveat of that derived body. It is a simulation observable, not a measured biological one.

rear_leg_diagnosis.weight_shift_hypothesis: DISPROVED. SHIFT_PROBE.json: the three rear legs already carry almost nothing in the stand pose (LH 0.08, RH 0.00, RM 0.00 body weight at reset), and every candidate push makes them carry MORE (0.17-0.66). A weight shift forward is not what the rear legs are missing; that hypothesis is withdrawn.
rear_leg_diagnosis.real_cause: the hand-made lift directions in LIFT_DEMO.json were the weak link. Measured rise over 90 ticks: RM hand-made +0.0000 (it drives only four joints) versus Jacobian-at-current-pose +0.2089; LH hand-made +0.0124 versus Jacobian +0.0563. RM could not lift at all because its fallback direction was degenerate, not because of its body position.
